n, k = map(int, input().split())
digits = []

while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % k)
    n //= k

answer = 0
shift_sum = sum(digits)

for i in range(len(digits)):
    shift_sum -= digits[i]
    for j in range(digits[i] - 1, -1, -1):
        answer = (answer * k + (shift_sum + j) % k)

print(answer % 1000000007)
